rationale: I traced the runtime path from /fly/+page.svelte buildArcs → transferEllipse. With actual mission dates, transferEllipse produces absurd midpoints: Voyager-2 arc midpoint dips to 0.179 AU, New Horizons to 2.49 AU (should be ~10+ AU), and inspiration-mars to 0.163 AU. This happens because transferEllipse hardcodes a = (r1+r2)/2 (the Hohmann assumption) and always picks the first focus candidate from its two-circle intersection, which for non-180° transfers creates an extremely eccentric ellipse that passes far too close to the Sun. The decoy outboundArc is the older function that /fly no longer calls; the cheap agent likely modified it without realizing the rendering pipeline now exclusively uses transferEllipse.
